values.meaning: healing per charge to Taric and nearby allied champions
values.quote: '''Taric''' {{tip|heals}} himself and nearby allied champions for {{as|25|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% of his '''maximum''' health)}} per charge

values.meaning: recharge time per charge of Starlight's Touch

mechanics.claim: The heal is applied for each stocked charge, up to the maximum charges, prioritizing Taric's own circle then the Bastioned ally's circle.
mechanics.quote: The healing will apply heal effects (such as {{ri|Summon Aery}}) prioritizing targets in '''Taric's''' circle, based on proximity to him, then in the {{ai|Bastion|Taric|Bastioned}} ally's circle, based on proximity to that ally (including it).

mechanics.claim: Bravado-empowered attacks each grant one charge of Starlight's Touch.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ais|Bravado|Taric}}'' empowered attacks each grant one charge.

mechanics.claim: Casting consumes all stocked charges (cost includes 'all charges').
